method: Manual closed-volume reconstruction with original video photographic front projection. Photogrammetry was attempted on 88 frames, but failed at image alignment.
frontTextureSource: IMG_6142.MOV, 145.3 seconds; silhouette/proportions cross-checked with front.jpg
geometryNote: Revision uses a nearly level frontal frame, uniform XY scale and reduced depth. Relief is deliberately shallow to avoid fabricated facial and weapon deformations. Side and rear volumes remain approximate, not a measured scan.
dedication: Ваш подвиг будет жить вечно в памяти белорусского народа
